knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The needle is not touched by an untrained person. The area is kept clear and the right people are notified.
Cleaning before disinfecting is the order the register sets, and protection and segregation come first.
Large or unknown material is outside routine scope, so the crew stops and escalates.

practicalCriteria: Stops and does not touch a simulated sharp, and notifies the named contacts
Protects, segregates, scrapes, cleans and disinfects a small simulated body fluid spill in order
Bags contaminated waste for disposal under the procedure
Washes hands and covers a simulated cut with a waterproof dressing
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
evidenceRequired: sharp sighting record or body fluid clean-up record
stopWorkCriteria: A sharp is handled by an untrained or unprotected person
A large or unknown body fluid scene is cleaned without escalation
Food, drink or smoking takes place in the area
